newsitem.title: USA: U.S. sex-case sergeant pleads guilty to misconduct.
newsitem.headline: U.S. sex-case sergeant pleads guilty to misconduct.

text.p: Army Staff Sgt. Delmar Simpson pleaded guilty Monday to 11 counts of unlawful sexual intercourse with female trainees at the scandal-plagued Aberdeen Proving Ground.
Earlier, in an early morning court session closed to reporters, Simpson entered not guilty pleas to charges of raping eight women at the proving ground, army spokesmen said.

The 11 guilty pleas were included in a total of 16 guilty pleas to charges of violating army general orders. Simpson, a drill instructor at the proving grounds ordnance centre and school, described in court having what he said was consensual sex with two of the women as the judge began a count-by-count recitation of the charges.
The Army forbids sex between drill instructors and trainees.
Simpson said the sex was initiated by the two privates about whom he was asked.
Jury selection in Simpson's case was expected to follow completion of the plea process, which spokesmen said may take most of the day.
